Thanks Michael — looping in the marketplace & alliances team to triage.

Karthik / Ben / Vanessa — CloudGrid is an ISV building a data orchestration add-on that maps nicely to our Private and Dedicated customers. They asked for the co-sell intake & publish checklist and a rough timeline. I scanned their deck and it looks like standard publisher evidence (integration docs, demo, SOC2).

Proposed split of work:
- Karthik: own GCP publisher checklist & technical evidence validation
- Ben: co-sell commercial guardrails and partner motion (deal routing / enablement)
- Vanessa: PM to coordinate listing metadata and go-to-market comms

Michael — can you share the SOC2 summary and a 10–12 minute demo recording? If you can provide a short mutual action plan (MMP) we can put dates against the milestones below.

Suggested timeline (subject to evidence completeness):
- Intake & checklist review: 3–5 business days after we receive docs
- Technical validation & demo review: 7–10 business days
- Listing submission -> GCP approval: variable (expect 2–4 weeks)

I'll kick off an internal tracker and drop an initial MMP template.

-Kim

Thanks Kim — quick checklist & immediate asks from the technical side. Michael, copying what we'll need to validate and to move to publisher submission: 

Required for GCP publisher form & our co-sell readiness:
- Integration docs (API spec + auth details)
- Demo recording (10–15 min walkthrough of integration)
- Short architecture diagram (PDF)
- SOC2 summary (or attestation) + data handling statement
- Pricing SKU mapping (per-seat / usage) and any metering endpoints
- Contact for publishing admin (email)

We also recommend attaching a one-page compatibility note on supported model versions and any expected latency characteristics.

Attachments I'm dropping internally: gcp-publisher-checklist.pdf (this is our internal checklist). Michael — can you upload the SOC2 summary and demo to a shared Drive link or reply with attachments? Once we have those I'll slot a 30-min intake call next week to review technical gaps.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference
